# Splendor Car Wash

> Online smart car wash booking platform with real-time bay availability and calendar scheduling.

## Core Services
- [Online Booking (Georgian)](https://splendor-beryl.vercel.app/ge): Reserve car wash bays in real-time with calendar slot selection
- [Online Booking (English)](https://splendor-beryl.vercel.app/en): Reserve car wash bays in real-time with calendar slot selection
- [Services and Packages](https://splendor-beryl.vercel.app/ge): Exterior wash, interior cleaning, express detailing and ceramic coating
- [Branch Locations](https://splendor-beryl.vercel.app/ge): Check active branch locations and working hours

## Optional
- [Admin Portal](https://splendor-admin.vercel.app/): Management portal for administrators and car wash operators
